field_principles.schema: A versioned shape lets readers reject incompatible evidence.
field_principles.experiment: The experiment number binds this result to REQ-ARC-WMTE-6765.
field_principles.title: The title states the frozen paired question and its prerequisite.
field_principles.run_date: The planning date fixes the requested evidence period.
field_principles.status: The status separates complete, blocked, and partial evidence.
field_principles.field_principles: Each top-level field states why it exists.
field_principles.inference_substrate: The substrate excludes CPU, remote, and helper-only substitutes.
field_principles.duration_s: Monotonic wall time makes live work visible.
field_principles.random_seed: Frozen science and bootstrap seeds make the comparison repeatable.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: One digest detects any design, row, or receipt drift.
field_principles.models_used: Exact model paths and hashes prevent substitution.
field_principles.model_specs: This alias lets the artifact verifier inspect exact model evidence.
field_principles.live_model_invoked: The flag distinguishes live evidence from a blocked denominator.
field_principles.frozen_manifest: The manifest proves the Exp6753 design stayed fixed.
field_principles.rows: One row per game, seed, arm, and canary keeps failures visible.
field_principles.gpu_receipts: Per-row device and VRAM facts prove CUDA residency.
field_principles.lease_receipts: Per-row ownership, release, and recovery prove exclusion.
field_principles.prompt_tokens_by_arm: Row-derived token totals show realized prompt cost.
field_principles.tool_calls_by_arm: Row-derived calls show how each prompt used production tools.
field_principles.useful_fetch_rate: A fetch counts only when later successful code used its response.
field_principles.transition_utility_delta: Net changed-cell utility is the second quality axis.
field_principles.mean_prompt_token_savings: Baseline minus treatment tokens measures the intended saving.
field_principles.change_fidelity_by_arm: Arm means expose absolute quality before a paired delta.
field_principles.change_fidelity_delta: Treatment minus baseline change fidelity is the main effect.
field_principles.change_fidelity_interval: The frozen game-clustered interval supports non-inferiority.
field_principles.noninferiority_margin: The frozen Exp6753 noise floor limits an allowed quality loss.
field_principles.harmful_regressions: Games below the frozen margin remain visible.
field_principles.paired_analysis: Per-seed and per-game rows make every reducer reproducible.
field_principles.adoption_gate_conditions: Named booleans separate adoption from completion.
field_principles.adoption_gate_passed: Adoption needs savings and non-inferior change fidelity.
field_principles.object_table_ab_completed: Completion needs all attributable science and canary rows.
field_principles.solve_claim: False prevents induction evidence from becoming a solve claim.
field_principles.source_receipts: Input hashes and source-boundary facts prove the allowed evidence path.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: The full gate record explains admission or a block.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Named observed values make blocked and terminal decisions auditable.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: False states that this quality measurement is not an oracle verifier.
field_principles.verdict_class: A closed class makes the scientific result machine-readable.
field_principles.honest_verdict: The terminal prefix states the owned outcome without a solve claim.
